name: 原创全真卷 01（基线 · 略易）
note: 结构与真考一致：7 部分 32 题，Q1-30 各 1 分，Q31/Q32 各 15 分，原始分 60，限时 60 分钟。

items.text:
SCHOOL LIBRARY
Closed on Friday afternoon.
Open again on Monday, 8.30 am.
options: The library is open on Friday afternoon.
You cannot use the library on Friday afternoon.
The library opens at 8.30 on Friday.
items.explain: Closed on Friday afternoon = 周五下午不开。

items.text: Sam, I'm still at work. Please cook the rice before I get home. Grandma will bring the vegetables at six. Mum
items.explain: Please cook the rice —— 蒸米饭是萨姆的任务；菜是奶奶带来。

items.text:
SWIMMING POOL
Children under 8 must come with an adult.
No food in the pool area.
items.q: Who needs an adult with them?

items.text: Hi Anna! The film starts at 4.30, not 5.00. Meet me at the bus stop at 4.00, OK? Kate
items.q: Why did Kate send this message?
options: The film time changed to earlier.
She cannot go to the film.
items.explain: 4.30 not 5.00 → 电影提前了，所以 4 点碰头。

items.text:
ART CLUB
Wednesday 3.30-4.30
Bring your own pencils. Paper is free.
items.q: What do students need to bring?
items.explain: Bring your own pencils；纸是免费提供的。

items.text:
GREEN'S FRUIT SHOP
Today only: bananas half price!
Open 9 am - 7 pm
items.explain: 只有香蕉半价，不是全部水果。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Mike
profiles.text: On Saturday I played football with my brother in the park. It rained in the afternoon, so we watched a film at home. I love films about animals.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Jenny
profiles.text: I visited my grandma on Saturday. We made dumplings together and she told me stories. On Sunday I did my homework and drew a picture of her house.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Paul
profiles.text: I went swimming on Saturday morning and won a small prize! On Sunday my family ate lunch at a new restaurant near the river. The fish was great.

questions.q: Who cooked food with a family member?
questions.explain: Jenny 和奶奶一起包饺子（made dumplings）。

questions.q: Who stayed at home because of the weather?
questions.explain: It rained… so we watched a film at home。
Paul 一家在河边新餐厅吃午饭。
Jenny drew a picture of her house。

part3.title: My Dog Coco
part3.passage:
My name is Ella and I have a dog called Coco. She is three years old and she is brown and white. Coco came to our family when she was a baby. My uncle's dog had four puppies, and he gave one to us.
Every morning, Coco wakes me up at seven o'clock. She jumps on my bed and makes funny sounds. After school, I take her to the park near our house. She loves running after her red ball, but she never brings it back! My dad says Coco thinks the ball is her baby.
Last month, Coco was ill and did not eat for two days. We took her to the animal doctor. Now she is well again and eats a lot. My mum says she eats more than me!

questions.explain: 叔叔家的狗生了四只小狗，送了一只。

questions.q: What does Coco do every morning?
questions.explain: wakes me up at seven o'clock。

questions.q: What is funny about Coco and the ball?
options: She does not bring it back.

questions.explain: Coco was ill and did not eat for two days。

questions.q: What is the best name for this story?
options: A day at the animal doctor.
questions.explain: 全文围绕「我可爱又好笑的宠物」——主旨题。

part4.title: Pandas
part4.passage: Pandas are big black and white animals. They (1) ___ in the mountains of China. A panda (2) ___ most of its day eating bamboo. Baby pandas are very (3) ___ — a new baby is smaller than your hand! Pandas can (4) ___ trees very well. Many people visit zoos to (5) ___ pandas. We must look after the mountains, because pandas need a safe (6) ___ to live.

gaps.explain: spend time doing 花时间做某事。
a safe place to live 安全的住处。

part5.passage:
Hi Nina,
How are you? I want to tell you about (1) ___ new hobby. Every Tuesday I go (2) ___ a cooking class with my mum. Last week we made noodles and they (3) ___ delicious! The teacher is kind and she gives (4) ___ a new recipe every time. (5) ___ you like cooking too? Maybe you can come with us (6) ___ Tuesday!
Love, Su

gaps.shape: 空格后是名词 → 限定词
last week + they → 过去的等号
动词 gives 后面 → 宾格
gaps.explain: gives us a recipe 给我们（me 也通）。

gaps.shape: 句首 + 问号 → 助动词
gaps.explain: Do you like cooking? 问句请 do 举手。

p6.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Alex.

Hi! My family is coming to your city next month! What is the best place to visit? What food should we try? Can you meet us one day?
Alex
